GATE Cutoff Summary: IIT Patna

The GATE 2025 cutoff for IIT Patna for M.Tech admission ranges from 747 to 218 for the General category. For M.Tech Computer Science and Engineering, the Round 1 cutoff is 747, and the last round cutoff is 704. M.Tech Artificial Intelligence recorded a Round 1 cutoff of 743 and a last round cutoff of 681. Other competitive courses for admission, such as Mathematics and Computing, VLSI Design & Embedded System, and Mechanical Design, have a cutoff range from 678 to 414.

Less sought-after branches including Material Science and Engineering, Chemical Engineering, and Rock Engineering and Underground Structures show a cutoff score between 463 and 218. For OBC candidates, the Round 1 cutoff is 710 for Computer Science and Engineering, and the last round cutoff is 299 for VLSI Design & Embedded System. In the SC category, the range is 598 in Round 1 for Computer Science and Engineering to 232 in the last round for Material Science and Engineering.

For ST candidates, the range is 486 for Computer Science and Engineering to 222 for Material Science and Engineering. Under the EWS category, the admission cutoff ranges from 727 for Computer Science and Engineering to 310 for Chemical Engineering.
